area.scope.heading: The same repair costs differently in a courtyard building, a house and a tower
area.scope.1.why: In East Rogers Park's courtyard buildings one boiler heats every apartment, so the owner or association signs off first.
area.scope.2.why: Rogers Park has many rental buildings, so the landlord books and approves the repair. Tell us who owns the system.
area.scope.3.why: Vintage Rogers Park apartments heated by radiators have no ducts, so cooling means window units or ductless mini-splits.
area.scope.4.why: Towers on Sheridan Road and courtyard buildings set the access: a key from management, service hours, the boiler room.
area.scope.5.why: Restaurants and shops run rooftop units and make-up air, so visits are booked around opening hours.
area.scope.6.why: The biggest swing of all. Where the unit has years left, we say so.

area.buildings.heading: What heats and cools your Rogers Park building
area.buildings.1.title: Courtyard building
area.buildings.1.body: One central boiler with radiators in every unit. The owner or association approves the work.
area.buildings.2.title: Two-flat or house
area.buildings.2.body: A boiler for the building or a furnace per floor, with the condenser in the yard or on the garage.
area.buildings.3.title: Lakefront tower
area.buildings.3.body: In-unit fan coils or air handlers on a building loop. Management approval and elevator booking first.
area.buildings.4.title: Shop or restaurant
area.buildings.4.body: Rooftop units and make-up air on Morse, Clark and Howard, scheduled around opening hours.

area.faq.heading: Rogers Park HVAC, answered
area.faq.1.q: Our courtyard building's boiler keeps failing. Does it need replacing?
area.faq.1.a: Not always. We diagnose first, and where the boiler has years left, we say so. Replacement is quoted only when repairs stop making sense for the building.
area.faq.2.q: Do you come as far north as Rogers Park?
area.faq.3.q: Can I get air conditioning in a radiator-heated apartment?
area.faq.4.q: Does HVAC repair in Chicago need a permit?
area.cta.body: Have the make of your boiler, furnace or condenser to hand, and tell us what it's doing. In a courtyard building, mention who looks after the boiler.

extras.districts.4.hvac: HVAC here: furnaces and splits in newer buildings, boilers in older ones.
extras.faq.2.a: Yes. The shop is at 1225 N Cleaver St in West Town, about seven miles south, and Rob runs the calls from there. Call (773) 238-3838 to book.
extras.faq.3.a: Usually, yes. Radiator-heated apartments have no ducts for central air, so it means a window unit or a ductless mini-split. In a rental, the landlord approves it first.
extras.faq.4.a: No. Chicago doesn't require a permit to repair, diagnose or maintain heating and cooling. Permits cover installs and construction, so a company's permit count says little about its repair work.
extras.faq.5.a: Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturday, 6:00 AM to 3:30 PM. Call (773) 238-3838.
